13 June 2002

## Circular to All SFC's Registered Securities Dealers and Securities Margin Financiers

## Financial Resources (Amendment) Rules 2002

The Securities and Futures Commission has recently amended the Financial Resources Rules ('the FRR') to incorporate the following two new requirements:

- -To apply a 80% haircut to collateral that may be difficult to liquidate quickly because of the size of holding relative to monthly turnover (taking an average over 6 months) and market capitalization;
- -To include a financial adjustment in ranking liabilities where a firm's total borrowings, which are secured by repledging margin clients' securities, exceed 65% of aggregate margin loans provided to margin clients.

Details of these requirements are described in the Financial Resources (Amendment) Rules 2002  ('the  Amendment  Rules')  which  were  gazetted  on  31  May  2002.  A  copy  of  the Amendment Rules and the Consultation Conclusions can now be found on the SFC's Internet website at http://www.hksfc.org.hk.

The above new requirements will come into effect on 1 st October 2002 and will be applicable to all registered securities margin financiers and securities dealers providing securities margin financing.    Firms  are  strongly  advised  to  carefully  consider  the  financial  and  operational implications of the new requirements and ensure that they have the necessary data, systems and capital for complying with the new requirements for 1 st October 2002.

If you have any questions about the new requirements, you are welcome to contact your case officer  in  the  Intermediaries  Supervision  Department  (please  refer  to  the  attached  list  for name and telephone number of case officers).

Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission
